newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Jan 21.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Jan 21.

text.p: All major Mexican ports were reported open Tuesday, Communications and Transport Ministry said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

Moderative convective activity brought disperse clouds and rains to the area. Some clouds and humidity along the coasts of Sonora, Jalisco and Colima states. Winds from the north and northeast at 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 17 miles per hour) with waves four to six feet high.

A mass of cold air moving east and mixing with humidity from the Pacific causing wind and light rains along the coasts of Tamaulipas and Veracruz. Winds from the south and southeast from 15 to 20 knots (28 to 38 km/17 to 22 miles per hour) and waves from six to eight feet.

Moderate convective activity moving west along the coasts of Honduras and Nicaragua with moderate to light rains. Winds from the east and southeast at 15 to 20 knots (28 to 38 km/17 to 22 miles per hour) with waves four to six feet high.
